transcript.content: Hello, it's good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi… thanks for seeing me. I guess I came in because there’s been something I’ve been trying to make sense of, and I don’t want to sound dramatic or anything.

I’ve been feeling pretty convinced that one of my MBA classmates and a startup advisor are sort of… quietly coordinating opportunities for me. Like certain comments in class or messages on Slack feel like coded signals about where my career is supposed to go. I know that may sound unusual, but it feels really clear to me when it happens.
Have you been feeling unusually high, euphoric, or especially energized lately?

Yeah… I mean, I don’t know if I’d call it “high” exactly, but most days lately I’ve felt really switched on, like optimistic in this intense way. Like I’m right on the edge of something big happening.

It feels good, mostly. Productive, I guess. But I have noticed I’m a little more… sharp with people. I’ve snapped at teammates or my boyfriend over small delays, stuff that normally wouldn’t get to me. I’m not proud of that. Does that make sense?
Have you been needing much less sleep than usual?

I’m not totally sure… I don’t think it’s been that dramatic. I mean, maybe I’ve stayed up later than I should a few nights, but that also feels kind of normal with school and everything.

I wouldn’t want to overstate it. I haven’t really been tracking it closely.
Have there been times when you felt completely normal in your mood, but still believed those messages or comments were coded signals for you?

I don’t think so… at least, not that I can remember.

Before this whole stretch where I’ve felt so energized and driven, I don’t remember messages feeling coded like that. It kind of started after I began the MBA prerequisites and everything got more intense with the workload. Before then, comments just felt like comments.

And… I guess, if I’m being honest, the other thing with hearing my name when no one was there also wasn’t happening before that. I know that sounds weird, but it feels like it all began around the same time my mood and pace shifted. Is that helpful?
Do these coded messages feel like they mean you have a special talent, mission, or importance?

Kind of… yes. I mean, I don’t want to make it sound like I think I’m, like, chosen or anything dramatic.

But it does feel like these messages are pointing to something important for me — like my career is supposed to go in a specific direction, and maybe I’m being noticed because I have something unusual to offer. I’ve been really convinced that one of my classmates and this startup advisor are sort of… quietly coordinating opportunities for me. Like certain comments in class or Slack messages aren’t just random, they’re signals about where I’m meant to go next.

I know that may sound like a lot. I’m trying to explain it in a way that makes sense.
During this period, have you been much more driven to start or push forward with projects than is typical for you?

Yeah… I think probably more than usual, although I’ve been telling myself it’s just being motivated.

I’ve been starting extra work-type projects and trying to improve things for class, like rewriting team processes and organizing how everyone should schedule stuff. I’ve also been messaging people I met at networking events, trying to keep opportunities moving.

It’s not all bad, exactly… but I guess some of it has gotten a little ahead of me. Like I’m pushing forward on all these things, and then I’m not always following through on the normal tasks I’m supposed to be doing. I don’t know if that counts as “much more,” but it’s definitely more than my usual.
Have other people told you that you’ve been talking much faster than usual lately?

Yeah… a couple people have mentioned that, actually. I didn’t really think of it as a problem at first — I thought I was just excited or trying to be efficient.

But in meetings and study groups, people have said I’m talking really fast, or they’ll kind of laugh and say, “Slow down.” And I’ve noticed I’ll keep explaining my idea even when someone starts to jump in, which I know isn’t great. It’s like if I stop, I’m going to lose the thread or lose momentum.

I’m not trying to talk over people, though. I hope it doesn’t sound like I’m being rude.
Have you also had a period like this where, instead of feeling energized, you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?

I’m not sure I’d describe it that strongly. I mean, I’ve had down days, definitely, and periods where I felt kind of discouraged or drained… but “depressed most of the day nearly every day” sounds pretty intense.

I don’t think I’ve noticed anything like that in the same clear way as this energized period. Unless maybe I’m not thinking about it the right way?
Since the coded messages and hearing your name began, have those experiences been going on for less than one month?

No… I think it’s been longer than a month. Not forever or anything, but probably about two months now.

It started around when I began the part-time MBA prerequisite program while still keeping my operations job. I guess I was hoping it was just stress from taking on more, but… yeah, it’s been about two months.
Has there been a period of at least two weeks when you were still hearing your name or noticing coded messages, but your mood was otherwise pretty normal?

I don’t think so… I mean, not that I can clearly separate out.

Before this whole stretch where I’ve been more energized and really driven, I wasn’t having that coded-message feeling, and I wasn’t hearing my name when no one was there. That all seemed to start after my mood shifted and I took on the MBA prerequisites with everything else.

So… if you’re asking whether it was happening while I otherwise felt normal, I don’t think I can say that it was. Does that make sense?
